title: Add an improvement-cycle check for OLY-10-02 and record its mechanism
summary: Add a small, tested check in the introspection records layer that decides whether one job's chain shows a repair, a supported process finding, an evaluated candidate and an evidence-based adoption decision. Surface it in `athena status`, then set the OLY-10-02 mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml. Goal: Athena's owner can see whether the final acceptance chain is shown.

defaults_applied.how: New check has unit tests; fmt, clippy and test pass.
Criteria run tests that exercise shown and missing cases.
Empty record set reports not shown.
One focused check reusing existing proposal records.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs (IntrospectionRecord, FailureClass, ProposalRecord, ProposalStatus, ClassStatus types), crates/athena-cli/src/commands.rs (status entry point at status/status_snapshot) and crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs (status renderer, StatusView). I did not read how records validation is wired in detail; the producer must check check_record_file / AnyRecord and the round-trip test if any new record type is added under crates/. Prefer reusing existing ProposalRecord/ProposalStatus as the adoption decision rather than adding a new record type.

Existing code: crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs (proposals, classes, evidence), crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs status and crates/athena-cli/src/commands.rs status; docs/spec.toml OLY-10-02 entry at line ~1534. No existing 'adoption' term in crates/, so the decision is modelled with ProposalStatus.

The mechanism is a pure function that, given a job's linked records, reports each of four stages (repair landed, supported finding, candidate evaluated on cases, adoption decision with evidence) as present or missing; `athena status` prints a line such as 'improvement cycle: shown' or 'improvement cycle: not shown'.
The measure label will be a line `athena status` prints; the producer chooses the exact wording and cites it in the spec measure, ending with `status: <label>`.
No athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflow change is needed. Consumers: none found (no config deliverable).

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml OLY-10-02 has a mechanism naming an existing crates/ path and function (not "none"), owner Athena kept, and a measure ending in `status: <label>` where the label is a line `athena status` prints, or `status: not shown` plus the test name. Check with Grep on docs/spec.toml and the named path.

A unit test for the cycle check passes with the mechanism: a record set with repair, supported finding, evaluated candidate and adoption decision reports shown; each set missing one stage reports that stage missing. Run `cargo test -p athena-data introspection` (or the crate holding the check). The test fails if the check is stubbed to always return shown or always missing.
`athena status` output includes the improvement-cycle line, and a display test in crates/athena-cli asserts it for both shown and not-shown. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli status`.
An empty record set is reported as not shown, never as success (no-empty-success). Covered by a test.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` all pass.
Any new record or data type is covered by the records validation allow-list and its round-trip test (check_record_file/AnyRecord), or no new record type is added. Check by Grep in crates/athena-data.

out_of_scope: Running a real end-to-end demonstration with a live defect
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass odds than reference: the change spans data, CLI and spec, and the exact record shape was not fully surveyed.
